data.description:

data.creator_notes:
Vaguely inspired by a few other cards i'd seen on here!
Also, this is my first time making a card thats a 'place' instead of a person, so I hope it works out alright. 
Feedback/criticism is very much appreciated!  :D   Let me know what sucks, or if its broken, or needs some tweaks. It's worked pretty well in all my tests so far. (Using a local 22b model on my own pc, anyway)

Basically its a nightclub/tavern/sauna/brothel, owned and run by goblin girls.
Come on in, have a seat, get something to eat or drink, or even just grab a random girl and have some fun!
The intro is probably the biggest thing i've written so far, just trying to get you in the right mood and mindset for this place, but I also didn't wanna go overboard with token shit.
